info.name: Data AVAX Supply Looking Glass API
Get NFT holders by contract address

params.name: pageToken
params.description: A page token, received from a previous list call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. The minimum page size is 1. The maximum pageSize is 5000.

params.name: chainId
params.description: A supported evm chain id. Use the `/chains` endpoint to get a list of supported chain ids.

params.name: address
params.description: Contract address on the relevant chain.

items.docs: Get list of NFT holders and number of NFTs held by contract address.
